text: Keep the last attempt's design. Two fixes from the verifier: (1) build the scratch repository's pre-C0 history so it passes the old history rules (a bootstrap commit, then a job landed the old way with trailers, then the cutover job), so athena check --history passes on the post-C0 base with no violations at all; do not assert on violations. (2) Test the post-C0 fallbacks through their real entry points: athena status's trace of a post-C0 job and the auditor reading a post-C0 job's files, each in the scratch repository.
